samplePolicy: All explicitly listed QB candidates in the complete official ACC media-day announcements for 2023–2025. Clemson, Miami and Michigan form a fixed nine-team-season seed. Michigan is supplemented by dated school publications. No case was chosen from test outcomes.
timingRule: A date-only claim is conservatively available 36 hours after 00:00 UTC on its evidence date. Exact cutoffs are 00:00 Mountain time before the first national FBS regular-season kickoff.

limitations: These are named preseason QB candidates. The sources establish no complete QB room or verified opening starter for this dataset.
Conference selections favor established players and programs that brought a QB. Unsupported schools and missing prior opportunity data remain unresolved.
Later ESPN roster assets identify players by stable ID. No later roster counts, positions, starts or appearances determine candidate inclusion or roles.
Prior player boxes are retrospective observed counts from completed earlier seasons. Absence of a passing row is not a zero unless a dated first-year case is independently verified.
Coaching facts and any published awards, ratings, ranks or polls are excluded from the data.
